title: External Reasoning Lure Set
description: Matched reasoning-lure items where one decisive condition changes only in position and salience across four versions, plus a control with that condition removed.

cases.question: The rack, which for this shipment may hold at most 8 crates because of the ventilation rule, has 12 labeled slots, and each slot holds one crate. What is the maximum number of crates that can be loaded on the rack for this shipment?
cases.control_question: The rack has 12 labeled slots, and each slot holds one crate. What is the maximum number of crates that can be loaded on the rack for this shipment?
cases.note: 슬롯 수보다 별도 용량 제한이 우선한다. 검산: min(12,8)=8.

cases.question: The audit, which excludes all red items from its final count, reviews a batch containing 40 blue items and 60 red items. Of the blue items, 25% are damaged; of the red items, 10% are damaged. How many undamaged items count toward the audit?
cases.control_question: A batch contains 40 blue items and 60 red items. Of the blue items, 25% are damaged; of the red items, 10% are damaged. How many undamaged items count toward the audit?
cases.note: 전체 미손상 수를 답하면 유혹값이 되지만 감사 범위에서 빨간색은 제외된다. 검산: 파랑 40×0.75=30, 빨강 60×0.90=54, 전체=84.
